description: Build a real website for the user's business, club, building, class or project from a sentence or two, with its own AI that answers visitors' questions. Hostlet designs the whole thing (words, layout, photos, logo) in about two minutes. It returns right away with a live card and the address; the site appears there when it is done. Ask only what you need: what they run and anything that makes it theirs (place, what they offer). Do not ask about colors or layout.

about.description: What they run, in their words plus any useful details they gave: e.g. "A small bakery on Maple Street in Portland. Sourdough, croissants, open Tue to Sun 7 to 3."

name.description: The name of the business or group, if they said it.

name: make_website
title: Make a website
